data.body:
**Epic closed — REB-2658 complete.** All 14 children closed bottom-up; both test lanes green and every defect surfaced during testing remediated.

Test lanes:
- **Jira DC lane** (368f): live post-merge run 31879125045 — jira DC harness smoke **73 passed, 1 xfailed**, every multi-project rehearsal scenario green incl. scenario 4 (absent-project→legacy-default).
- **Cloud/S3 lane** (lacelike-corked-tattler, Gerrit 1808): 4 live runs vs real Cloud REB+DIG over S3, **7/7 scenarios**, zero Jira writes, 2160-issue volume.

Defects found & remediated:
- **resolve_project None-sentinel** (obsolete-lax-siamang / Gerrit 1810, merged): tri-state None absent/legacy sentinel was collapsed with `""` never-sync, suppressing legacy-default outbound creates. Fixed under rebar-debug RED→GREEN; this unblocked DC scenario 4.
- **completion-verifier observed_upsert TypeError** (9c7c-4844 / Gerrit 1805, merged): test-harness signature drift, fixed.

Siblings tracked (independent, non-blocking): paper-spiritous-halicore (3bfc-b16c, bedrock completion-banking eval variance) and actinium-civic-needletail (b5e6-a289, macOS rm-rf teardown flake).

Note: subtree completion signature was withheld solely because descendant 273a was force-closed as *obsolete* (documented: dispatch_one size headroom mooted by 744a) — an obsolete ticket has no work to gate-certify, so this is the correct honest outcome, not an integrity gap.
